name: cbt.thought-record
title: CBT · Thought Record / Cognitive Restructuring
description: Examine a distressing situation, automatic thoughts, emotions, and evidence to find a more balanced alternative.

name: cbt.activation
title: CBT · Behavioral Activation
description: Schedule a small, meaningful or rewarding activity rather than waiting for motivation.

name: cbt.exposure
title: CBT · Exposure
description: Plan a gradual approach to a safe, everyday situation you fear or avoid.

name: cbt.experiment
title: CBT · Behavioral Experiment
description: Test a belief with a small, safe real-world experiment and review what actually happens.

name: cbt.problem-solving
title: CBT · Problem Solving
description: Define a practical problem, compare options, try one manageable action, and review it.

name: cbt.thinking-patterns
title: CBT · Identify Cognitive Distortions
description: Notice recurring thinking habits—including catastrophizing, mind reading, and discounting the positive.

name: cbt.downward-arrow
title: CBT · Downward Arrow
description: Gently explore what an automatic thought might mean to uncover a deeper assumption or belief.

name: cbt.worry-time
title: CBT · Worry Time / Stimulus Control for Worry
description: Give your what-if thoughts space in an adjustable timed writing session.

name: cbt.activity-mood
title: CBT · Activity–Mood Monitoring
description: Record activities alongside mood, energy, pleasure, and mastery to notice useful patterns.

name: cbt.graded-task
title: CBT · Graded Task Assignment
description: Break an overwhelming task into manageable steps and build from a small success.

name: dbt.pause
title: DBT · Pause and observe
description: Notice the situation and an urge, then decide whether to pause, seek support or take a safe next step.

name: dbt.interpersonal
title: DBT · Clarify a request or boundary
description: Balance your objective, the relationship and self-respect before drafting your own words.
